title: Block Logger
description: Logs the block you're looking at with the press of a key
body:
A simple client-side utility mod that logs block registry names to a text file.

- Press O (configurable) while looking at any block
- Automatically adds the block's registry ID (modname:block) to BlockLogs/blocks.txt in the Minecraft directory
- Client-side only

_This mod is intended for modpack development._
